summary: OpenAI announced a new 'Premium' seat tier for ChatGPT Business priced at $125/user/month (or $100 annually) that provides 5x more usage than Standard seats and removes the five-hour usage limit, alongside a signup promotion offering workspace credits.

mechanisms.reason: The new seat tier explicitly gives heavy users more usage capacity and removes a usage cap, increasing tokens served per user.
mechanisms.quote: Premium gives your most active teammates 5x more usage than Standard seats and removes the five-hour usage limit, so they can take on larger projects and work with fewer interruptions

practices.reason: Workspace admins now need to manage mixed seat types, billing tiers and usage limits within ChatGPT Business, creating minor administrative overhead.
practices.quote: Workspace owners and admins can: Mix Standard and Premium seats across the same team. Upgrade or reassign seats as business needs change. Monitor usage across the workspace. Manage billing, usage, and spend limits in one place.
